description: This file defines the `TodoProvider` class, a state management class for handling a list of `TodoItem` objects, including operations like adding, editing, toggling completion, filtering, and deleting todo items. It serves as a central provider for todo list data and UI filtering in a Flutter application.

classes.name: TodoProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing a list of TodoItem objects with methods for CRUD operations and filtering.

methods.name: items
methods.description: Returns the list of todo items filtered according to the '_showCompletedOnly' flag.

methods.name: showCompletedOnly
methods.description: Getter to check whether only completed items should be shown.

methods.name: setFilter
methods.description: Sets the filter to show only completed items or all items and notifies listeners.

methods.name: addTodo
methods.description: Creates and inserts a new TodoItem with a generated ID, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: editTodo
methods.description: Edits an existing TodoItem identified by id, updating its title and/or subtitle.

methods.name: toggleCompleted
methods.description: Toggles the 'completed' status of the TodoItem with the given id.

methods.name: deleteTodo
methods.description: Removes the TodoItem with the specified id from the list.
